hotspots.title: Javier Milei's Central Bank reform push
hotspots.blurb: President Javier Milei is aggressively pushing for a reform of Argentina's Central Bank, aiming to limit its ability to finance the treasury and prioritize currency value preservation. The reform is a cornerstone of his economic agenda and has sparked intense debate among legislators and provinces.
hotspots.affect: This commands disproportionate attention due to its high-stakes implications for Argentina's economic stability and Milei's political future, framed as a moral crusade against inflation and fiscal irresponsibility.

hotspots.title: Iran's revenge threats against Western leaders
hotspots.blurb: Iran has escalated its rhetoric and actions against Western leaders, including U.S. President Donald Trump and Italian Prime Minister Giorgia Meloni, following renewed military strikes and threats over the Strait of Hormuz. The situation has heightened global security concerns.
hotspots.affect: This hotspot is charged due to the existential threat framing, geopolitical brinkmanship, and the potential for catastrophic escalation in the Middle East.

hotspots.title: Hungary's constitutional crisis over president's term
hotspots.blurb: Hungary's parliament, led by Prime Minister Péter Magyar, has passed a constitutional amendment to remove President Tamás Sulyok, a key ally of former PM Viktor Orbán. The move has sparked accusations of authoritarianism and deepened political divisions.
hotspots.affect: The crisis is highly charged due to its implications for Hungary's democratic institutions, Orbán's legacy, and the country's relationship with the EU.

hotspots.title: PiS internal feud over Ukraine aid
hotspots.blurb: Poland's ruling Law and Justice (PiS) party is deeply divided over its stance on Ukraine, with party leader Jarosław Kaczyński publicly rebuking MP Przemysław Czarnek for suggesting the suspension of EU military aid to Ukraine. The feud has exposed fractures within the party.
hotspots.affect: This commands attention due to its implications for Poland's foreign policy, internal party cohesion, and the broader European response to the Ukraine war.

hotspots.title: Vox and PP clash over climate change and immigration
hotspots.blurb: Spain's far-right Vox party and the conservative People's Party (PP) are locked in a bitter dispute over climate change policies and immigration, particularly following deadly wildfires in Almería. Vox has accused the PP of betraying its principles by aligning with left-wing narratives on climate change.
hotspots.affect: The controversy is highly charged due to its moral framing around national identity, environmental responsibility, and the role of government in crisis response.
